user.title: Create merged calendar
user.description: Cal Combiner automatically creates its own calendar that new events are written to by default. You can add more source calendars now or later in the panel.

data.name: Name
data.sources: Extra source calendars to merge in (optional, can be added later)

filter_rules.title: Filter for {entity_id}
filter_rules.description: Leave both fields empty to remove the filter. Separate multiple words with commas.

data.include: Only include events containing (e.g. Zoo, Petting Zoo)
data.use_regex: Treat the words as regex patterns instead of plain text

abort.no_sources: Add at least one source calendar under "Edit sources" before setting filters
